title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three op

translated_title: 在错误发生处捕获：LLM推理过程中的实时错误纠正
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被信任承担数学、科学和工程工作，但它们的错误往往写得十分自信且难以察觉。一个错误的步骤往往会持续传播，导致模型在错误的前提上浪费推理token。现有的保障措施要么只检查最终答案然后从头重新生成，要么依赖一个验证器LLM——它会与主模型竞争GPU算力并拖慢响应时间。我们提出了在线确定性验证：许多类型的推理步骤可以通过代码进行验证，因此一个步骤在被生成的同时就能得到实时验证，无需任何模型调用或GPU使用。每当检查失败时，我们指出错误所在，并让模型从同一位置继续推理。我们在符号数学上演示了这一方法，因为其中的推导过程已包含显式表达式，计算机代数系统可以在毫秒级内完成检查。在ASyMoB基准测试上，使用三种操作符（运算）进行了评估……
tldr: 提出在线确定性验证方法，利用计算机代数系统等代码工具在LLM生成推理步骤的同时实时校验（无需GPU或额外模型调用），发现错误时让模型从出错处继续而非从头重来，从而避免错误传播并节省推理开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes online deterministic verification that validates LLM reasoning steps in real time using code (e.g., computer algebra systems) without any GPU usage or model calls, allowing the model to resume from the exact point of failure instead of restarting, thereby preventing error propagation and saving inference cost.
